Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

Can you credential our employed staff, not only contractors?

Yes. The program covers your own employees as well as clinicians placed through us.

Do you work to our standards or yours?

Yours. We start from your policies and the requirements of your accrediting body, and document to them.

How do we see the status of a file?

You receive regular reports, and your compliance lead can ask for any file at any time.
